Why should I join FTMO?
Why should I join FTMO?

Trading is difficult. While trading, you may face many common problems such as:

Trading an account that is too small (undercapitalisation)
Fear of losing your own money
Psychological pressures
Lack of discipline
Growth limitations
Insufficient support from your surroundings
How does FTMO help?

Making a living as a retail trader, especially if you intend to use your own money, is tough. With the FTMO Prop Trading firm, you can hone and prove your skills on an FTMO Challenge or an FTMO Instant Account, and receive real monetary Payouts for your performance without risking your own capital on the live markets.

To receive a Reward from the FTMO Challenge product, you must first reach the FTMO Account phase. The simulated profit created during the Evaluation Process does not grant you eligibility for a Reward.

Our three products, 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account, let you choose the conditions that fit your trading style. For the 2-Step FTMO Challenge, we will refund you the initial purchase fee once you request your first Reward withdrawal, using the same payment method you used.

Having experience with trading ourselves, we understand that to be a great trader, you need more than just enough capital to trade with. It is in our interest to provide our clients with conditions under which they can perform at their best. Our clients will receive wide access to our innovative Trading Applications, which can enhance their trading edge, and they will also receive detailed feedback from our company. FTMO Traders and clients with an FTMO Instant Account who have placed their first trade may also periodically consult with our Trading Psychology Coach free of charge.

Last but not least, there is the trading discipline that we emphasise. You cannot be all loosey-goosey with the FTMO accounts. Our rules are designed to teach you professional risk management habits and ultimately make you a better trader.

Why is there a fee?
Why is there a fee?

The fee covers the costs associated with providing the FTMO Challenge and the FTMO Instant Account products, including the design, development, and operation of the FTMO platform and its technical infrastructure, which supports our educational services and proprietary applications. The amount of the fee depends on the selected product (1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge, or FTMO Instant Account) and the size of the simulated account balance.

By paying the fee, you gain access not only to the FTMO Challenge or the FTMO Instant Account in the simulated trading environment, but also to FTMO’s proprietary applications designed to support your learning and performance, such as the Statistical Application, Mentor Application, Account and Trader’s Analysis, Account MetriX, trading calculators, and other tools and content available to our clients.

For the 2-Step FTMO Challenge, we will refund you the initial purchase fee once you request your first Reward withdrawal, using the same payment method you used.
For the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account, the entry fee is not refundable.

Who is an FTMO Trader, and how do I become one?
Who is an FTMO Trader, and how do I become one?
An FTMO Trader is an FTMO client who holds an FTMO Account initiated from the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge products, or holds an FTMO Instant Account, and becomes eligible for their first Reward on that particular account.
An FTMO Account is an account in which the FTMO client is eligible for a monetary Reward, provided the rules are followed. Results on an FTMO Instant Account count towards the monetary Reward from day one, provided the rules are followed.
The journey of becoming an FTMO Trader via the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge
Phase 1: FTMO Challenge

You trade on a simulated trading account and must meet all its Trading Objectives, such as the Profit Target and Consistency or Minimum Trading Days (depending on the product), without breaching your Maximum Loss Rule or Maximum Daily Loss Rule. FTMO assesses eligibility to pass the Challenge phase immediately, once you pass all Trading Objectives and close all trades. The Evaluation Process for the 1-Step FTMO Challenge ends with the FTMO Challenge phase; the Verification phase is not applicable.

Phase 2: Verification

For the 2-Step FTMO Challenge, the Verification phase represents a simplified continuation of the FTMO Challenge phase. You must pass the Verification phase to receive an FTMO Account.

Phase 3: FTMO Account

Once you pass the Evaluation Process and your results are confirmed, you will become an FTMO Trader and will receive your FTMO Account. Successful results on the FTMO Account earn monetary rewards, provided you follow the rules.

The journey of becoming an FTMO Trader via the FTMO Instant Account

FTMO Instant Account does not include the FTMO Challenge or Verification phase. However, the Trading Objectives apply. Traders must still meet the Consistency requirement without breaching their Maximum Loss Rule or Maximum Daily Loss Rule. Successful results on the FTMO Instant Account count towards the monetary Reward, provided you follow the rules. You become an FTMO Trader once your first Reward is approved.

Can I modify my platform or account type?
Can I modify my platform or account type?

With the exception of the Free Trial accounts, our system allows you to modify certain account parameters, provided no trades have been placed on the current account. After you pass a phase or receive a reward, you get a new account where the modification can be processed.

You can make all available modifications directly in Account MetriX by clicking the “Modify” button in the upper section and confirming your request.

Platform modification is available for all accounts.
Account types may be changed from Swing to Standard, but not vice versa.

How to start?
How to start?

Before you decide to start a 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account, we want to make sure that you understand how the process works and what is expected of you.

Choosing your product

After you sign up at https://trader.ftmo.com/, you can start by choosing one of our three products: 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account. The products differ in their Trading Objectives, pricing, and conditions. This allows you to select the structure that best matches your trading style and experience.

To help you get familiar with these products, we offer a Free Trial, a simplified version of these accounts. You can see more information about our Free Trial via the attached link. You may repeat the Free Trial as many times as you need to feel well prepared.

Setting up your account

Once you are ready, you can configure your account by selecting your product and account size. Key parameters:

Our accounts can be denominated in USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, CZK, CAD or AUD. The chosen account currency does not determine the currency in which we send you a reward.
Accounts are paid for with a one-time fee; no further fees are charged.
Available trading platforms are MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader or TradingView.
Important note

Please note that it is not possible to obtain an FTMO Account based on any external trading track record. To qualify for a Reward, you must successfully meet the Trading Objectives and applicable eligibility requirements of the selected account.

What is FTMO?
What is FTMO?

FTMO is a project focused on identifying experienced traders with proven trading skills. To assess these abilities, we offer the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and 2-Step FTMO Challenge products, through which we evaluate trading performance and risk management. For highly experienced traders with strict risk management, we also offer the FTMO Instant Account.

Upon successful completion of the relevant FTMO Challenge phase for the 1-Step FTMO Challenge product, or the FTMO Challenge and Verification phase for the 2-Step FTMO Challenge product, a trader may gain access to an FTMO Account, where rewards are paid based on achieved results, in accordance with the conditions of the respective product. For the FTMO Instant Account product, the results count immediately towards the reward amount, provided all rules are strictly followed.

The trader’s journey is demanding, which is why we provide our clients with educational applications, detailed account analyses, and support from an experienced Trading Psychology Coach to help them continuously improve their trading performance.

Who can join FTMO?
Who can join FTMO?

Apart from the exceptions listed below, FTMO CFDs is available to clients globally, and we accept registrations from natural persons as well as legal entities.

No specific qualifications are required. Whether you are a beginner or already know your way around trading and are interested in improving yourself, you’re the person we’re looking for.

FTMO CFDs availability is subject to internal business decisions and changes in compliance with evolving legal and regulatory standards.

FTMO does not provide FTMO CFDs to the following categories of individuals:

Persons under the age of 18;
Persons (both nationals and residents) from Iran, Syria, Myanmar, and North Korea;
Individuals listed on international sanctions lists;
Individuals with a criminal record related to financial crime or terrorism;
Persons previously banned due to a breach of contract;
Corporate clients structured as company trusts;
Conditional exceptions

Nationals of Iran, Syria, or Myanmar may be accepted only if both of the following conditions are met:

They provide valid documentation confirming residency in a country that is part of the European Economic Area (EEA);
We are able to verify a bank account held in their name, issued by a traditional bank (not a neobank or fintech) operating within an EEA country.
Residency-based restrictions

Due to business decisions based on risk management considerations, FTMO does not provide FTMO CFDs to clients in the countries and regions listed in the following table.

Clients in Australia can use FTMO services facilitated via our affiliated entity at https://ftmo.com/au/

You are also welcome to join our community on Discord.

We let our clients speak for us.

I paid for my order, when will I get the account?

We start processing your order as soon as we receive the payment. In most cases, it takes no more than a few hours to create your account. In rare cases, the process may take up to 24 hours.

Please ensure that you keep your login credentials secure and do not authorise anyone else to access them. FTMO cannot be held responsible if your account is accessed by a third party.

How do the different accounts provided by FTMO differ?
How do the different accounts provided by FTMO differ?

FTMO offers three different products. Those products primarily differ in Trading Objectives, available account sizes, price, and number of phases. Please read the introduction to the phases below, visit our Comparison Table, and read through our website for a complete understanding. Additionally, all trading is processed on simulated accounts; our clients do not trade with real capital.

The 2-Step FTMO Challenge product includes an Evaluation Process consisting of two phases, the FTMO Challenge and Verification, and the FTMO Account phase, where the FTMO client becomes eligible for a monetary Reward based on their trading success, provided the rules are followed.
The 1-Step FTMO Challenge product works on the same principles as the 2-Step, but the Evaluation Process is shortened by removing the Verification phase and therefore contains only one evaluation phase.
The FTMO Instant Account is a product where results are immediately factored into the available Reward. Note that you still need to meet the applicable rules before any Reward withdrawal.

On top of those paid accounts, we also offer a Free Trial, where you can test out the trading platforms, rules, or your strategy.

What is the Swing account type, and how does it work?
What is the Swing account type, and how does it work?
What is an account type, and who is the Swing account type suitable for?

Account type changes the account’s leverage, the rule for holding trades during market close, and the rule for news trading.

Compared to the Standard account type, the FTMO Swing account type have:

No restrictions on trading during restricted news releases or holding positions past market close for more than 2 hours (e.g., over the weekend or overnight for equities), provided you avoid Forbidden Trading Practices.
However, the account’s base leverage is reduced from 1:100 to 1:30.

For this reason, it is suitable for swing traders who need to hold positions for longer periods of time and allow trades sufficient time to develop. This account type is typically used by fundamental traders who expect market sentiment to persist for several days or weeks, or by technical traders who analyse higher timeframes.

How can I get the Swing account type?

The FTMO Swing account type is available exclusively within the 2-Step FTMO Challenge product. It is not offered for the 1-Step FTMO Challenge or the FTMO Instant Account. When ordering a 2-Step FTMO Challenge, you can select Swing as your account type during the configuration process.

Please note that if you purchase an FTMO Challenge as a Standard account type, it is not possible to change it to a Swing account type at a later stage.

Can I modify the account type once the order is created?

You can request a change from a Swing account type to a Standard account type. We can process this change only for accounts with no trades. Note that we provide you with a new account once you pass each phase or withdraw a Reward. The new account is considered an account with no trades and is therefore eligible for the modification.

You may not change from the Standard account type to the Swing account type.

I have successfully passed, what to do now?

This article outlines the steps required to pass the evaluation phases of the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and 2-Step FTMO Challenge. FTMO Instant Account is excluded from this FAQ due to the nature of the product.

How long does it take to become an FTMO Trader?
How long does it take to become an FTMO Trader?

The time required to become an FTMO Trader and receive an account where the results are counted towards your Reward depends on whether you participate in the 1-Step FTMO Challenge, the 2-Step FTMO Challenge or the FTMO Instant Account, as each product follows a different structure.

1-Step FTMO Challenge

Due to the Consistency rule, it is possible to complete the 1-Step FTMO Challenge in as few as 2 trading days, provided that exactly 50% of the total profit is achieved on each of two separate trading days.

There is no maximum time limit to complete the 1-Step FTMO Challenge. Once all Trading Objectives are met and your trades are reviewed, you may proceed to the next steps toward obtaining an FTMO Account. In total, you can start trading on your FTMO Account after as few as 2 trading days. Results on the FTMO Account count towards the monetary reward, provided the rules are followed, and you become an FTMO Trader by receiving the FTMO Account.

2-Step FTMO Challenge

The minimum requirement to pass the FTMO Challenge is to trade for at least 4 Trading Days (they do not need to be consecutive).

The same minimum requirement applies to the Verification phase, where you are again required to trade for at least 4 Trading Days.

There is no maximum time limit to complete the 2-Step FTMO Challenge, allowing you to progress at your own pace. Once all Trading Objectives are met and your trades are reviewed, you may proceed to the next steps toward obtaining an FTMO Account. In total, you can proceed to your FTMO Account after as few as 8 Trading Days. Results on the FTMO Account count towards the monetary reward, provided the rules are followed, and you become an FTMO Trader by receiving the FTMO Account.

FTMO Instant Account

Your results count toward the monetary Reward right away, provided the rules are followed. You can request your first Reward 14 days after the first trade is placed, and you become an FTMO Trader once your first Reward is approved.

What is the legal relationship between an FTMO Trader and FTMO after signing the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions?
What is the legal relationship between an FTMO Trader and FTMO after signing the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions?

An FTMO Trader is officially considered to be a client to whom the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions currently apply.

The relationship between an FTMO Trader and FTMO is based on the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions, which we will sign with you after you successfully meet the applicable Trading Objectives (for 1-Step FTMO Challenge, the Trading Objectives are met by passing the FTMO Challenge. For 2-Step FTMO Challenge, the Trading Objectives are met after passing both the FTMO Challenge and Verification) and complete the KYC/KYB process.

If you hold the FTMO Instant Account, its terms are set out in two documents which you accept when ordering the product: FTMO Challenge Terms and Conditions set out primarily the purchase of the product and simulated trading until you qualify for your first Reward at which point your Reward is processed according to, and all further simulated trading continues under, the FTMO Account Terms and Conditions.

The FTMO Account Terms & Conditions is a legally binding document defining both our and your duties and rights. If you are interested in a sample of the contract, please contact us at support@ftmo.com.

What is the process of signing the contract?

Once you meet the Trading Objectives of your 1-Step FTMO Challenge or 2-Step FTMO Challenge, the FTMO Identity section will be unlocked in your Client Area. If you hold an FTMO Instant Account, you complete FTMO Identity when you request your first Reward. FTMO Identity is not re-created if your identity verification has already been processed and is active. In the FTMO Identity section, you will be able to save your personal or company details and related documentation and have them verified by our compliance team. The compliance checks usually take less than 1 business day for personal registrations and up to 3 business days for company registrations. Once all the information is verified by our compliance team, it will be securely stored in our system, ready to be used in case you wish to start using your FTMO Account(s) or conclude a new FTMO Account Terms & Conditions.

There are three different types of identities to choose from when verifying your identity:

Natural Person (In this case, you would need to undergo the KYC – Know Your Customer verification process. A valid government-issued ID document showing nationality and Proof of address are required)
Entrepreneur (In this case, you would need to undergo the KYB – Know Your Business verification process. A valid government-issued ID document showing nationality, a document confirming the registration as an entrepreneur and Proof of address are required)
Company (In this case, you would need to undergo the KYB – Know Your Business verification process. A valid government-issued ID document showing nationality and Proof of address of the representative of the company, a document confirming the legal existence of the company, and Proof of address of the company are required)

By default, our system allows you to proceed with the verification for the entity you chose when creating your first order. If you would like to change your status (Natural Person / Entrepreneur / Company), message us at support@ftmo.com. Note that the change of status is limited to one per registration. The status change option can also be utilised later, provided you are an active FTMO Trader and no trade has been placed on your currently active FTMO Account(s), e.g. after the Reward withdrawal, when a new FTMO Account is provided.

Once you pass your KYC or KYB check, the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions will be unlocked for your review and signing in your Client Area, FTMO Traders, Contracts. You will be able to read through the contract and use your FTMO Identity to complete it with just a few clicks. This step does not apply to the FTMO Instant Account, as you sign the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions when purchasing the account; once your FTMO Identity is approved, the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions are automatically applied.

The Client Area is designed to be intuitive and self-explanatory and to provide most of the necessary information for you, but you can always contact our customer support if you need help or assistance.

Natural Person (individual)

To conclude the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions and subsequently invoice payouts as a natural person, you will use the Natural person option and you will be asked to provide:

Valid government-issued ID document showing nationality, typically the passport or ID card. In case your ID document is solely in one of the following languages, please use an international passport with the Latin alphabet transcription of information: Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Bengali, Burmese, Dari, Dhivehi, Farsi, Georgian, Hindi, Khmer (Cambodian), Kinyarwanda, Lao, Mongolian, Nepali, Sinhalese, Urdu. Note that we don’t accept driving licences, residence permits or other documents that don’t display nationality.
Proof of address which has to be a complete document and must contain your name, surname, your address, and issuing date, such as: a bank statement, account statement, lease agreement, letter from a recognized public authority, or utility bill (gas, electricity, water, internet, etc.).

Please ensure that your Proof of Address is no older than 6 months and clearly displays your full name, full residential address, and the issuing date.

Entrepreneur (legal entity)

To conclude the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions and subsequently invoice the payouts as an entrepreneur (a natural person with a business licence), choose the Entrepreneur option. You’ll be guided through a two-step process: identity verification and information collection about the entrepreneur.

Step One: Identity Verification

This step verifies the entrepreneur’s identity. Required documents include:

Government-issued ID: Passport or ID card showing nationality. In case your ID document is solely in one of the following languages, please use an international passport with the Latin alphabet transcription of information – Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Bengali, Burmese, Dari, Dhivehi, Farsi, Georgian, Hindi, Khmer (Cambodian), Kinyarwanda, Lao, Mongolian, Nepali, Sinhalese, Urdu. Note that we don’t accept driving licences, residence permits or other documents that don’t display nationality.
Proof of Address: Such as a bank statement, invoice, or utility bill. Must contain your name, address, and issuing date, and be no older than 6 months.
Step Two: Collection of Information about the Entrepreneur and Supporting Documents

Required Information:

General Information: Registration number, VAT number (if applicable), registered address, country of registration and contact information.
Representative Details: Name, date of birth, citizenship.
Ownership Structure: Information on any possible shareholder with more than 25% of company shares (UBO/ultimate beneficial owner) – relevant for entrepreneurs from some jurisdictions, in case there is no other shareholder than you, please fill in information on you as an entrepreneur.

Required Documents:

Registration Confirmation: Such as a certificate of incorporation, recent excerpt from a state registry, etc. Must not be older than 12 months.
Proof of Address of the Entrepreneur: Bank statement, invoice, account statement, lease agreement, utility bill, extract from a state registry/another equal document from a state registry, certificate of incumbency, or other similar corporate documents.

Language Requirements:

We accept documents written in the Latin alphabet, as well as in Arabic, Serbian, Ukrainian, Russian, and Japanese. Documents in the Latin alphabet are processed faster. If you submit documents in Arabic, Serbian, Ukrainian, Russian, or Japanese, the process may take more time. Provide translations into English/French for documents in other alphabets.

If the submitted documents are insufficient, additional information or documents may be requested after assessment.

Company (legal entity)

To conclude the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions and subsequently invoice the payouts by a legal entity (you have to be a director and shareholder of the concerned company), choose the Company option and you will be asked to provide:

Official documents supporting basic information about the legal entity:

A document confirming the legal existence of the company, such as a certificate of incorporation/registration, recent excerpt from a state company registry, certificate of incumbency, certificate of good standing, memorandum/articles of incorporation/association/registration, or other similar documents.
A document enabling the identification of all the Ultimate Beneficial Owners (persons with more than 25% share) of a company, such as a shareholder registry, statement of information, recent excerpt from a state company registry, certificate of incumbency, memorandum/articles of incorporation/association/registration, trust agreement, or other similar documents. Please note that bank statements are not accepted as confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Owners’ status.
Proof of address, such as bank statement, invoice, account statement, lease agreement, utility bill, extract from a state registry/another equal document from a state registry, certificate of incumbency, or other similar corporate documents.

The provided documents cannot be dated more than 12 months before the date of submission and their combination must provide evidence to verify:

The company’s name
The company’s registration number
The legal form (type) of the company
The registered address of the company
The date of incorporation

If we find the documents insufficient, you may be asked to provide additional information/documents after the provided documents are assessed.

In case the legal entity has several corporate layers (i.e. intermediary holding companies), the relevant documents confirming the company’s legal existence should be provided in respect of each company.

Information about persons acting on behalf of the company in relation to the business relationship with FTMO (FTMO Traders).

Valid ID document showing nationality – passport or ID document. In case your ID document is solely in one of the following languages, please use an international passport with a Latin alphabet transcription of information – Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Bengali, Burmese, Dari, Dhivehi, Farsi, Georgian, Hindi, Khmer (Cambodian), Kinyarwanda, Lao, Mongolian, Nepali, Sinhalese, Urdu. Note that we don’t accept driving licences, residence permits or other documents that don’t display nationality.
Authorisation to act on behalf of the company (no need to upload the authorization in case you are the director of the company or any other official with executive powers recorded in the respective state registry).

Note that we cannot sign a contract with nonprofit organizations or Trusts, just as with companies that are owned or co-owned by nonprofit organizations or Trusts.

How do I withdraw my reward?
How do I withdraw my reward?

Although FTMO Traders trade with simulated capital only, they are entitled to receive a Reward in the form of real money once they generate a profit on their FTMO Account, provided all Trading Objectives are fulfilled and the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions are followed.

Steps of the Reward withdrawal process
You request a Reward claim in the Account MetriX. This can be done on the 14th or any following day after the first trade is placed on the specific account. All open positions and pending orders must be closed before requesting the Reward. If you trade on the FTMO Instant Account and have not completed your FTMO Identity yet, you will be asked to complete it when you request your first Reward. We cannot start processing your Reward until your FTMO Identity is approved.
After you submit the withdrawal request, we will review your account and notify you within 1–2 business days.
Once we approve your Reward, you can submit all necessary information for the withdrawal in the FTMO Traders section. Following this process, the Reward is typically sent within 1–2 business days after the invoice is approved.

Warning: When making a Reward withdrawal from an FTMO Account, obtained via the FTMO Instant Account product, your Maximum Loss Limit does not reset. It is your responsibility to ensure the Reward withdrawal does not result in a breach of the Trading Objectives.

Withdrawal Methods and Limits

Rewards can be paid out via bank wire transfer, instant transfer through Visa Direct / Mastercard Send (up to $20,000), Skrill (up to $3,000), or cryptocurrencies. FTMO does not charge any additional commissions for Reward withdrawals. Note that due to transaction fees, there is a minimum closed profit requirement of at least $20 for bank wire withdrawals and transfers via Visa Direct or Mastercard Send and $50 for cryptocurrency withdrawals, to cover the cost of the transaction.

Reward Ratios and Account Growth
FTMO Account initiated from the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account: You receive a Reward according to 90% of the simulated profit.
FTMO Account initiated from the 2-Step FTMO Challenge: By default, you receive a Reward according to 80% of the simulated profit. If the Scaling Plan or Premium Programme conditions are met, the Reward Ratio is increased to 90%.
Reward Rollover

FTMO Traders on FTMO Accounts initiated from the 2-Step FTMO Challenge can request to roll over their Reward to the subsequent FTMO Account. Before the Rollover, the standard applicable Reward Ratio is applied. However, once the FTMO Trader decides to withdraw rolled-over Reward, the Reward Ratio is 100% to avoid reducing the Reward by the Reward Ratio twice.

The minimum rollover amount is €20, $20, £20, 20 AUD, 20 CAD, 20 CHF, or 500 CZK.

FTMO Points

Instead of a Reward payout, you can choose to receive your Reward (in whole or in part) as FTMO Points during the Reward processing. One FTMO Point equals 1 EUR. FTMO Points can be used exclusively to purchase services and/or products from FTMO or our affiliates and cannot be exchanged for cash (real money) or other monetary value. For more information, see the FAQ “What are FTMO Points, and how can I use them?“.

Taxes

Please bear in mind that you are solely responsible and liable for the payment of any and all taxes, levies, or fees that apply to you in relation to the FTMO Account Terms & Conditions under the applicable laws and regulations. FTMO is neither able nor authorised to provide any tax advice or instructions.

What are the Trading Objectives?
What are the Trading Objectives?

Trading Objectives are the key rules that define when an account is breached, when the Evaluation Process is passed, and when the client becomes eligible for a Reward. We describe all Trading Objectives in detail on the Trading Objectives page.

Violation of the Trading Objectives
The Consistency rule cannot be violated; it can always be passed by generating additional profit
The Minimum Trading Days rule cannot be violated; it can always be passed by continuous trading activity
If you breach a Maximum Loss or Maximum Daily Loss rule, the platform automatically closes all your open positions, and the account is considered failed, and you lose the account.

How does your Consistency rule work?
How does your Consistency rule work?

FTMO has a Consistency rule applicable to:

the 1-Step FTMO Challenge, including its FTMO Challenge as well as the FTMO Account phase, and
the FTMO Instant Account.

The 2-Step FTMO Challenge product has no Consistency rule, but you must follow the Minimum Trading Days rule.

The purpose of the rule is to ensure that no single trading day accounts for too large a share of your total profit. This prevents one outsized day from carrying the whole result.

To find more information about the Consistency rule, please visit the Trading Objectives page.

What is the difference between Balance and Equity?
What is the difference between Balance and Equity?

Balance represents the realised value of your account and changes only when a trade is closed. Open (unrealised) positions do not affect the balance.

Calculation of the balance = initial account balance + realised total net profit and loss

Equity represents the real-time value of your account and reflects its current value including open positions. Equity fluctuates continuously based on the profit or loss of open trades.

Calculation of equity = balance + unrealised net profit and loss

Disclaimer: Please note that commission and swap fees may be reflected in your account balance before a trade is closed, depending on the trading platform’s specific configuration.

Can I trade news?
Can I trade news?

FTMO restricts order execution for 2 minutes before and 2 minutes after selected news releases for all accounts, excluding the exceptions mentioned below. You are allowed to hold open positions on the targeted instruments if they were opened more than 2 minutes before the restricted event. This restriction applies to any order execution, including your Stop Loss, Take Profit or any other pending orders. Violating this rule may result in termination of an FTMO Account / FTMO Instant Account.

A restriction applies only to symbols that include the affected currency/symbol. Trading on non-targeted instruments is not restricted. For example, during the US NFP release, you may trade EURGBP or AUDNZD; however, you must not open or close trades on USDJPY or GBPUSD within the time window of 2 minutes before and 2 minutes after the NFP release.

This restriction does not apply to:

any Swing type accounts
any accounts in the FTMO Challenge or Verification phase.

With these accounts, you can trade during any news freely, provided that the Forbidden Trading Practices are avoided.

Can I merge my accounts?
Can I merge my accounts?

Only FTMO Accounts can be merged. If you wish to combine multiple FTMO Accounts into a single FTMO Account, this can be arranged upon request, provided that all of the following conditions are met.

Conditions
FTMO Accounts to be merged are unused (no trade executed)
FTMO Accounts to be merged are in the same base currency
FTMO Accounts to be merged originate from the same product
Important information
If you have already started using an FTMO Account, you can fulfil the first condition by withdrawing the Reward.
You can merge Swing FTMO Accounts as long as the combined initial balance does not reach the size of the FTMO Challenge, where the Swing option is not offered. If your merged initial balance reaches this limit, we can process the merge by providing a Standard account type.
If a Swing type FTMO Account is merged with a Standard type FTMO Account, the merged FTMO Account will be a Standard type account.
The resulting merged FTMO Account will have a combined balance as well as correspondingly adjusted drawdown limits.
Once your FTMO Accounts are merged into a single FTMO Account, the merge is irreversible.

How many accounts can I have?
How many accounts can I have?
Maximum Allocation

FTMO applies limits on the maximum capital allocation as part of our risk management and diversification measures. Circumventing these limits through different registrations is strictly prohibited. If identical or substantially similar trading is detected across multiple FTMO accounts, including trades copied from or based on the same third-party source (such as signal groups or copy-trading services), and the total fictitious capital exceeds the following limits, FTMO reserves the right to suspend the affected accounts.

At any given time, the total capital allocation across all accounts and products is limited to $400,000 per trader or strategy (prior to any scaling). This Maximum Allocation increases if the Premium Programme benefit is applied.

For other base currencies, the equivalents of the $400,000 limit are: €320,000, £280,000, CAD 480,000, AUD 520,000, CHF 320,000, or CZK 8,000,000.

Other Limits

The number of active FTMO Instant Account products is limited to one.

What is the Discipline Score?
What is the Discipline Score?

The Discipline Score is a separate metric from the Consistency rule that applies to the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account product.

The Discipline Score is an informative metric in your Account MetriX that helps you evaluate consistency and better understand your trading behaviour based on individual trading-day results. A higher score indicates more evenly distributed and consistent performance over time.

Please note that the Discipline Score does not affect eligibility for passing the FTMO Challenge or Verification phases, or eligibility for the Reward withdrawal on an FTMO Account.

What is 'Trading according to a real market'?

Trading must be legitimate and must not rely on practices that contradict the functioning of a real market. A trading strategy is allowed provided it does not:

Interfere with legitimate trading.
Exploit practices intended to cause us harm.
Misuse the Evaluation Process or FTMO Account in any way.
Breach the Forbidden Trading Practices.

We recommend that you get familiar with:

How FTMO works
FTMO Challenge Terms & Conditions
Forbidden Trading Practices

Please note again that all trading via the FTMO platform (Free Trial, FTMO Challenge, Verification, FTMO Instant Account or FTMO Account) is simulated only, with only fictitious capital available. However, we may use the data obtained from FTMO Accounts to trade on our own separate live accounts. Hence, we emulate the conditions of a real market and require our clients to apply proper risk management. And when you trade on a real market (e.g. via a proprietary trading firm), you have to follow the rules.

Which instruments can I trade, and what strategies am I allowed to use?
Which instruments can I trade, and what strategies am I allowed to use?

You can access a simulated trading environment and trade asset classes. The full list of available instruments is published on our Symbols page and shown on your trading platform.

Your trading style is up to you. As long as your trading is legitimate and in line with proper risk management, conforms to the real market conditions, and does not constitute Forbidden Trading Practices, we have no reason for limiting or restricting your trading strategy, whether it’s discretionary trading, algorithmic trading or EAs. When trading, keep in mind that your trading style should be replicable on live accounts to generate the same results as on your FTMO Challenge, FTMO Account or FTMO Instant Account. We do not require you to use a Stop-loss (although it’s generally advisable to always have certain safety measures in place). You can trade all the instruments and assets that are available in your trading platform (Forex, Indices, Commodities, Stocks, Crypto,…).

If you intend to use trading robots (Expert Advisors – EAs), keep in mind that if you use an EA from a third party, there might be other traders already using the same EA and therefore exactly the same strategy. By using a third-party EA, you potentially run a risk of being denied the FTMO Account if you exceed the maximum capital allocation rule.

Please note that platform servers have a limit of 200 orders at a time and 2000 max positions per day, as well as limited acceptance of server messages (orders and order modifications such as updates of TP/ SL and updates of limit orders). If your EA causes hyperactivity to a platform server, we might alert you and ask you to adjust the EA logic or parameters of your strategy.

Please beware of practices that have nothing in common with serious trading. If we identify such practice, we reserve our right to take the necessary action to mitigate risk. This might vary from removing the conflicting positions, rebalancing the account, or terminating the account completely and ceasing our cooperation altogether. You may refer to the Forbidden Trading Practices page for more information on what constitutes Forbidden Trading Practices. Please use our services with genuine intentions and show us your edge in the markets and consistency that you can be proud of.

How does the FTMO technical infrastructure work?
How does the FTMO technical infrastructure work?

FTMO provides simulated trading services and educational tools for traders. Since the beginning of FTMO, our objective has been to provide traders with conditions as similar as possible to the real market in all parts of the Evaluation Process (1-Step FTMO Challenge or 2-Step FTMO Challenge), Free Trial, FTMO Account, and the FTMO Instant Account. In the Free Trial, you can check our trading setup and try it out for free, and we always recommend our clients try it before purchasing any of our products.

Any account provided by FTMO is an account with fully fictitious funds, including the FTMO Account; however, it uses real market quotes from liquidity providers. Please note that liquidity providers do not provide FTMO with any real money (liquidity), only with the market quotes. Our clients therefore never actually perform any trades on live markets.

In a separate process, FTMO also trades on its own account (outside of the FTMO platform) with real financial means. While performing its own trades, FTMO may also use trading data obtained from its clients’ FTMO Accounts. FTMO continuously monitors and analyses the trades executed by FTMO Traders in the demo environment and subsequently evaluates whether trades will be executed for FTMO’s own account. This execution occurs without any impact on FTMO’s clients and their simulated trading. These two processes are separate, and in no way is the FTMO Trader influenced by FTMO’s trading. To learn more about the execution policy & trading conditions, please see our blog article.

Can I experience any execution delays?

Execution delays are always present in real market trading. It happens on all trading platforms and trading servers. To simulate this on FTMO’s servers, we apply a delay which reaches up to 200 ms. Other factors that contribute to execution delays are the geographical location of the server/data centre, internet connection, and latency. Execution delays are not set up on an individual basis but indiscriminately for all clients on a particular platform. On MetaTrader 5, you can view the execution speed in your platform terminal, journal section.

Why does FTMO charge a commission on some asset classes?

In order to best emulate how financial markets operate and in line with market standards, we also include simulated commissions when executing trades. All commissions applied to each symbol can be found by everyone on our website and on the trading platform. This is another important part of getting close to how the real market works and testing trading skills in the most accurate conditions, as if they were in the real market. We pride ourselves on having one of the industry’s lowest and most competitive commission structures.

Does FTMO apply hidden markups or added slippage?

We do not add hidden markups or additional slippage. Trades are executed according to the pricing visible on the trading platform. In the case of slippage, the executed price was affected due to the technical delay that we explained above. Slippage can be both positive and negative without any preference.

How does copying trades affect FTMO Traders?

In case FTMO wishes to replicate a client’s trades, the replication technology runs in a separate environment without interfering with the client’s account. The trading conditions remain the same on the client’s platform, regardless of whether the client’s trades are replicated or not.

Password

Read-only password to only visit the platform

Do you offer a Free Trial?

We offer a Free Trial account, which is an abridged version of the FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account experience.

The purpose of the Free Trial is to help new clients familiarise themselves with our trading environment and tools and assess their trading approach before starting the 1-Step FTMO Challenge, the 2-Step FTMO Challenge, or the FTMO Instant Account.

Successfully completing a Free Trial is a strong indicator that you are ready for our paid offering. However, please note that passing the trial does not guarantee future success, grant reward eligibility, or secure an FTMO Account.

Regardless of your Free Trial results, you must successfully meet the conditions of the selected product to become an FTMO Trader and receive monetary rewards. The Free Trial is intended as a preparatory experience, not a qualification step.

With your Free Trial, you can also use most of our proprietary applications, including the Statistical Application, Account MetriX, Trading Journal, and a shortened version of the Account Analysis.

For more details, see the dedicated Free Trial page.

How about trading psychology? Any help here?

Certainly. We know very well that psychology can be a major obstacle for many traders. We too have experienced things like overtrading, revenge trading, greed, FOMO, etc. It is said that 80% of success in trading is devoted to a proper state of mind, controlled emotions, and psychological stability. That’s why we have partnered with educated Trading Psychology Coaches, and we offer their services to all our FTMO Traders.

Holders of the FTMO Instant Account can use the Trading Psychology Coach services at intervals of a minimum of 30 days. Eligibility for Trading Psychology Coaching begins once the account is activated by placing the first trade.
Holders of the FTMO Account initiated from the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge products can use the Trading Psychology Coach services at intervals of a minimum of 14 days.

Review our Trading Psychology page for more information.

What are FTMO Points, and how can I use them?
What are FTMO Points, and how can I use them?

FTMO Points can be viewed as “vouchers” that participants can utilise in several ways. Unless stated otherwise, the availability of FTMO Points and the rules described below apply to the 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge, and FTMO Instant Account.

How to earn FTMO Points?

Clients can get FTMO Points in three ways:

By choosing FTMO Points as the alternative for Reward payout (whole or part of) to which the clients are entitled based on the particular FTMO Account Terms & Conditions during the Reward processing.
By choosing FTMO Points as the alternative for the fee refund for a previously purchased FTMO Challenge. Please note that fee refunds are available only for the 2-Step FTMO Challenge. The fee paid for a 1-Step FTMO Challenge or an FTMO Instant Account is non-refundable. Fee refunds can only be transferred to FTMO Points in full, not partially.
As part of special promotional campaigns. Particular rules will be determined during the marketing campaign.

One FTMO Point equals 1 Euro. In case your refund or Reward is in another currency, we will convert it using our rates and automatically display the amount of FTMO Points available for purchase. It’s important to note that FTMO Points cannot be exchanged for cash (real money) or other monetary value.

How to use FTMO Points?

FTMO Points are displayed in the Client Area under the Profile tab. Clients can use the FTMO Points exclusively to purchase services and/or products from FTMO or our affiliates. For example, the FTMO Points can be used as a discount when purchasing a new 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account, or even cover the entire fee (if the Client has FTMO Points corresponding to the fee available).

The FTMO Points will be applied to a particular purchase in the following order:

FTMO Points purchased with the refund for FTMO Challenge or Reward,
FTMO Points received as part of a promotional campaign.

Please be aware that the FTMO Points have an expiration date, which can be checked in the Client Area.

How do I qualify for the Prime Status?
How do I qualify for the Prime Status?

Prime Status is available to traders who meet the qualification criteria while trading on an FTMO Account, regardless of whether they qualified through the 1-Step FTMO Challenge or the 2-Step FTMO Challenge. The FTMO Instant Account product is not eligible for the Premium Programme.

Conditions to qualify for the Prime Status
You must not have failed an FTMO Account within the last 4 months.
You must finish at least 4 Reward cycles on FTMO Accounts originating from the same order, and generate a profit of at least 4% of the Initial Simulated Capital in each cycle.
Important information

The Rewards do not have to be consecutive, and the size of the Reward is assessed before the Reward Ratio is applied. Rollover from the previous FTMO Account is not considered as additional profit.

Please note that the qualification does not consider FTMO Accounts with contracts signed before 2023.

What are the benefits of Prime Status?

Prime Status represents a significant milestone in your trading journey, unlocking premium conditions for your FTMO Account.

While the core benefits of higher allocation and discounts apply to everyone, there are specific differences depending on whether you qualified through the 1-Step FTMO Challenge or 2-Step FTMO Challenge. The FTMO Instant Account product is not eligible for the Premium Programme.

Shared Benefits

All holders of Prime Status, regardless of their initial challenge type, receive:

Maximum Capital Allocation increased up to $600,000 (or the equivalent in other currencies)
1× Free FTMO Challenge of the same size as the approved FTMO Account (provided via FTMO Points)
Access to the $400,000 FTMO Challenge (or equivalent in other currencies) with a 10% discount
10% discount on all new purchases (not applicable for an FTMO Instant Account)
Different Benefits based on product type
Reward Ratio
2-Step FTMO Challenge: Your Reward Ratio is upgraded from 80% to 90% upon achieving Prime Status.
1-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account: You maintain your standard 90% Reward Ratio, which is included from the very beginning.
Rollover Bonus
2-Step FTMO Challenge: You are eligible for a 5% rollover bonus on the subsequent FTMO Account (withdrawable after 30 calendar days).
1-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account: Rollovers are not supported for this account type, so the rollover bonus does not apply.

How do I qualify for the Supreme Status?
How do I qualify for the Supreme Status?

To qualify for the Supreme Status, the following conditions must be met. These requirements apply regardless of whether you qualified through the 1-Step FTMO Challenge or the 2-Step FTMO Challenge. The FTMO Instant Account product is not eligible for the Premium Programme.

Conditions to qualify for the Supreme Status
You must not have failed an FTMO Account within the last 4 months.
You must have an active $400K Prime FTMO Account.
On the $400K Prime FTMO Account, you must finish at least 3 Reward cycles and generate a profit of at least 4% of the Initial Simulated Capital in each cycle.
Important information

The Rewards do not have to be consecutive, and the size of the Reward is assessed before the Reward Ratio is applied. Rollover from the previous FTMO Account is not considered as additional profit.

You can obtain a $400K Prime FTMO Account by:

Merging two $200K Prime FTMO Accounts into one $400K Prime FTMO Account
Merging two $200K regular FTMO Accounts into one $400K FTMO Account and passing all conditions required for Prime Status.
Merging a $200K regular FTMO Account with a $200K Prime FTMO Account. In this situation, you will lose the Prime Status and will have to qualify for the Prime Status again.
Purchasing a $400K FTMO Challenge, which is available for traders with Prime Status, and passing all conditions required for the Prime Status.

The conditions for merging FTMO Accounts are described in the FAQ “Can I merge my accounts?“.

Once I'm in the Premium Programme, do I keep it permanently?
Once I'm in the Premium Programme, do I keep it permanently?

The Premium Programme is tied to a specific order and applies to FTMO Traders participating in both the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and the 2-Step FTMO Challenge. The FTMO Instant Account product is not eligible for the Premium Programme. The programme is not limited by time.

Compliance with the Premium Programme conditions is assessed across all FTMO accounts within the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge products. This means that if you participate in multiple FTMO products (e.g. both 1-Step and 2-Step), any breach of the applicable rules may affect your participation in the Premium Programme as a whole.

You will be removed from the Premium Programme if any of the following situations occur:

You fail the only FTMO Account on which Premium Programme status is active
You fail a total of three accounts within the 1-Step or 2-Step FTMO Challenge products, regardless of the stage
You breach the contractual requirements of the Premium Programme

Is the Premium Programme compatible with the Scaling Plan?
Is the Premium Programme compatible with the Scaling Plan?

The Premium Programme and the Scaling Plan are two separate and independent programmes. FTMO Traders may participate in both programmes at the same time.

The Premium Programme is available to FTMO Traders who qualify through both the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and the 2-Step FTMO Challenge. The only difference in benefits for FTMO Accounts initiated through the 1-Step FTMO Challenge and the 2-Step FTMO Challenge is how certain benefits apply, depending on the product.

FTMO Traders who qualify through the 1-Step FTMO Challenge start with a 90% simulated Reward Ratio from the beginning, so there is no increase in the Reward Ratio upon entering the Premium Programme.

Apart from product-specific limitations (such as the unavailability of rollover bonuses for the 1-Step FTMO Challenge), the Premium Programme benefits are otherwise identical for FTMO Traders from both challenge types.

Neither programme is available for the FTMO Instant Account product.

What is the application and approval process?
What is the application and approval process?

Our application process is designed to identify suitable partners through a quick evaluation. To apply, you must first register an active account at trader.ftmo.com (FTMO) or trader.ftmo.oanda.com (FTMO US). Residents and nationals of some countries cannot join the Affiliate Programme, so please check Are there countries where I cannot refer clients or receive payouts? before you apply.

Application steps
Fill out the application form on our FTMO Affiliate Programme page, including a short questionnaire.
We evaluate your suitability based on the quality of your responses, your online presence, and how well your brand aligns with FTMO’s values and audience.
Applications are reviewed within 1 to 2 business days.
If approved, you will receive an onboarding email with all the necessary details to start promoting FTMO.

One application covers both programmes. When you first enter your Affiliate Dashboard after approval, you accept the Terms and Conditions of both the FTMO and the FTMO US Affiliate Programme. From then on, no additional step is needed to promote to US clients: switch your Affiliate Dashboard to the FTMO US view and your FTMO US affiliate link is ready there.

Are there country restrictions for affiliates and referred clients?
Are there country restrictions for affiliates and referred clients?

Yes, and the same restrictions apply on both sides of the programme: if FTMO cannot provide services to someone as a client, we also cannot pay them as an affiliate. Referred orders from restricted countries do not generate commissions, and affiliates residing in restricted countries cannot receive payouts.

Who can become a partner

The Affiliate Programme has two restrictions of its own, on top of the client restrictions: residents and nationals of Vietnam and Pakistan cannot join the Affiliate Programme. Clients from these countries can still be referred, subject to the product availability below. The restriction applies to becoming a partner.

Who can be referred, and where the authoritative lists live

The restricted-country lists are maintained in the eligibility FAQs, and this entry deliberately does not duplicate them, so there is exactly one place to keep current:

For FTMO clients: Who can join FTMO?
For FTMO US clients: Who can join FTMO US?
For FTMO Futures specifically: Who can join FTMO Futures?

Those pages carry the full list of countries where FTMO does not provide services, the categorical exclusions, and the conditional exceptions for nationals of Iran, Syria and Myanmar.

United States eligibility scope (FTMO US)

For the purposes of eligibility, the United States includes the 50 states as well as the following U.S. territories: American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, United States Minor Outlying Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. However, we do not currently accept entities from Arkansas, Delaware, Louisiana, Montana, or South Carolina.

FTMO Futures availability is narrower than for the FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account

FTMO Futures is available to individuals only: companies, legal entities, businesses and self-employed registrations are not accepted, so a company cannot be referred to FTMO Futures.

Futures access also differs by country, and for what you can earn there are three cases:

FTMO Futures available: subscription and Account Reset commissions apply. Some of these countries allow a Sim-Funded Account but not a Live Funded Account, but that difference affects the trader’s journey, not your commissions.
FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account only: no FTMO Futures at all, so only one-time commissions apply.
Fully restricted: no services, no commissions, and no affiliate payouts to residents.

The country lists are maintained in Who can join FTMO Futures? and can change, so always check there rather than assuming.

How do I earn commissions as an affiliate?
How do I earn commissions as an affiliate?

You earn commissions when a trader referred through your affiliate link or code makes a qualifying purchase. Your affiliate link covers all our products: 1-Step and 2-Step FTMO Challenge, FTMO Instant Account and FTMO Futures. Your affiliate code can currently be entered at FTMO Futures checkout only.

FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account: a one-time commission on the trader’s first purchase of each product, so their first 1-Step FTMO Challenge, first 2-Step FTMO Challenge and first FTMO Instant Account each earn you a commission, from 8% at Bronze up to 20% at Platinum.
FTMO Futures Evaluations: a recurring commission on every monthly Evaluation subscription payment your referred trader makes (capped at 12 months for this commission), from 10% at Bronze up to 18% at Platinum. You also earn on every Futures Account Reset they purchase (same cap applies), calculated at 50% of your current level (5% at Bronze, 6% at Silver, 7.5% at Gold and 9% at Platinum).

Commissions on subscription renewals and Account Resets are credited to the affiliate the account is attributed to. Attribution is decided when a new Evaluation account is purchased and does not change afterwards.

Commission rates are identical in the FTMO and FTMO US programmes. Your rates depend on your partner level in each programme, based on the total commissions you generate within a calendar month across all products. All affiliates start at Bronze and can progress through Silver, Gold and Platinum.

Note that each programme has its own level: your FTMO commissions build your FTMO level and your FTMO US commissions build your FTMO US level; they do not combine.

How does the affiliate levels system work?
How does the affiliate levels system work?

The affiliate level system rewards consistent performance over time. Your level is determined by the total commissions you generate within a calendar month, and commissions from all products count together. Updates are applied on the 18th day of the following month.

The core of the system is a three-month period. When you reach a new level, you keep its benefits and commission rates for the next three months. During this period, one of the following can occur based on your performance in any given calendar month:

Level Up: you advance if you meet the requirements for a higher tier, starting a new three-month period at that level.
Renew Level: you maintain your level by meeting its requirements again. Renewing Gold or Platinum also grants a free FTMO Challenge.
Level Down: if you do not meet the criteria to renew or advance within three months, your level adjusts based on your best-performing month.

How do FTMO Futures commissions work?
How do FTMO Futures commissions work?

FTMO Futures is sold as a recurring monthly Evaluation subscription rather than a one-time purchase, so it pays differently than the FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account. The mechanics below are the same in the FTMO and FTMO US programmes.

Recurring subscription commission. You earn a commission on every monthly Evaluation subscription payment your referred trader makes, at your subscription rate for your current level.

When the subscription ends. The Evaluation subscription is charged on the trader’s billing anniversary for as long as it stays active, and it ends in one of these ways:

They pass the Evaluation. The subscription is cancelled automatically and no further payments are charged, because the Sim-Funded Account and the Live Funded Account are not subscription products. Commission on that trader’s subscription stops at that point.
They cancel. Billing stops at the end of the period already paid for.
A payment fails. Access is paused, and if it is not resolved within the grace period the account is closed.
They are moved to a Live Funded Account. Their active Evaluations are closed. Commission on those subscriptions stops at that point.

Futures Account Resets. If a referred trader fails their Evaluation, they can purchase an Account Reset to start again. Every Account Reset earns you commission at half your subscription rate for that level.

The 12-month commission period. You earn FTMO Futures commissions on each referred trader for 12 months from the date of that trader’s first FTMO Futures Evaluation purchase, whichever affiliate it was attributed to, or none. The period is counted per trader, not per account: it starts once, with the trader’s very first Futures purchase, and does not restart when they buy further Evaluations, use a different affiliate code, or are referred by someone else. During the period you earn on all subscription renewals and Account Resets on accounts attributed to you. After 12 months, no further commissions are credited for that trader on any account.

Both subscription and Account Reset commissions count toward your monthly commission total for levelling. Recurring subscription commissions and Account Resets apply to FTMO Futures only.

What is my affiliate code and how do traders use it?
What is my affiliate code and how do traders use it?

Your affiliate code is a second way to receive credit for FTMO Futures referrals, alongside your affiliate link. Every affiliate has one from the start: it is your affiliate hash, the randomly generated 20-character code already contained in your affiliate link, for example xK9pQ2mVb7Lc4TnR8sWy, and you can copy it from your Affiliate Dashboard.

Affiliates at Silver level and above can choose a custom code of their own, and once created, a custom code stays active regardless of your level afterwards.

Traders enter the code in the Affiliate code field at FTMO Futures checkout when buying a new Evaluation, separate from the Discount field. The account, including its subscription renewals and Account Resets, is then attributed to you even if the trader did not arrive through your link.

The affiliate code does not change the price. It is not a discount code: discounts go in the separate Discount field, and a trader can use both an affiliate code and a discount code on the same order. The affiliate code’s only purpose is to credit the account to you.

Affiliate codes are currently entered at FTMO Futures checkout only. For FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account referrals, use your affiliate link. If a brand-new trader’s very first purchase is a Futures Evaluation with your code, they are paired to you as a trader and their later FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account purchases are attributed to you as well. You cannot use your own code or link for your own purchases.

How does attribution work for FTMO Futures referrals?
How does attribution work for FTMO Futures referrals?

Attribution for FTMO Futures works per Evaluation account.

When a trader you referred buys an FTMO Futures Evaluation, that account is attributed to you. You earn commission on the first subscription payment, every subscription renewal and every Account Reset on that account, for as long as the trader’s 12-month commission period is running. Any further Evaluation the same trader buys is attributed to you automatically as well, with no new link or code needed, unless they enter another affiliate’s code at checkout.

Affiliate codes take priority over affiliate links at checkout. If a trader enters another affiliate’s code when buying a new Evaluation, that new account is attributed to the other affiliate. Accounts already attributed to you are not affected and stay with you.

Only a code can do this. A trader who already has an FTMO account is not re-attributed by clicking another affiliate’s link, because links attribute a trader once, when their FTMO account is created. For a trader who already had an account before, another affiliate’s code affects that one Futures account only and does not change who the trader is attributed to for the FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account. A brand-new trader is different: if their very first purchase is an FTMO Futures Evaluation bought with your code, that code pairs them to you as a trader, so their later purchases, FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account included, are attributed to you too.

If a trader buys a new Evaluation without entering any code, the account is attributed to the affiliate who originally referred them.

Attribution is decided only at the moment a new Evaluation account is purchased. Renewals and Account Resets always follow the account they belong to and cannot be moved to another affiliate.

Example: a trader you referred buys a $50K Evaluation. You earn commission on all its renewals and Account Resets. Six months later the same trader buys a $150K Evaluation and enters another affiliate’s code. The $150K account is attributed to the other affiliate. The $50K account and everything it produces stay with you until the trader’s 12-month commission period ends.

This applies to FTMO Futures only. FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account referrals are attributed by link: the trader is attributed to the affiliate whose link they used, and you earn a one-time commission on their first purchase of each product (1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account).

Do traders I referred before the FTMO Futures launch earn me Futures commissions?

Yes. Subscription and Account Reset commissions are paid at your level rate at the time of each payment, and count toward your monthly level total as usual.
FTMO Futures country availability still applies.

This also works the other way around: if you referred a trader for FTMO Futures and they later buy an FTMO Challenge or FTMO Instant Account, their first purchase of each product (1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account) attributes to you automatically and earns you a one-time commission.

No action is needed on your side. Attribution follows your existing referral automatically.

How does the commission approval process work?
How does the commission approval process work?

Every commission you earn goes through an approval process before it is ready for payout. The process is the same in both programmes, with one difference in the fallback step, because the two programmes have different refund policies. In your Affiliate Dashboard, you will see a status for each commission indicating its current stage.

The approval process
Immediate commission approval: once your referred trader starts trading, your commission is approved immediately.
Automatic approval (fallback): if the trader does not start trading, FTMO commissions are approved automatically 14 days after the purchase date, matching the 14-day refund window. FTMO US has no refunds, so its commissions are approved without a refund holding period.
FTMO Futures renewals: each monthly subscription payment after the first is approved immediately. The holding period applies only to the trader’s first subscription payment.
Account Resets: commission on an Account Reset is approved immediately on purchase.
Understanding each commission status
Order not paid: an order was created using your link, but we have not yet received payment from the trader.
Processing: the trader has paid, and the commission is in the holding period awaiting approval.
Accepted: the commission has been approved and is now in your balance, ready to be paid out.
Rejected: the commission was not approved. A commission will be rejected if the order was cancelled or not paid, or if we manually rejected it for a rule violation, such as using an unauthorised promotion or attempting a self-referral.

In which currency are my commissions calculated and paid?
In which currency are my commissions calculated and paid?

Your commissions are calculated and tracked in each programme’s currency: EUR in FTMO, USD in FTMO US.

The FTMO Challenge and FTMO Instant Account are priced in each programme’s own currency, so no conversion is applied in either programme.

FTMO Futures is priced in USD everywhere, and what happens next differs by programme.

In the FTMO programme, a Futures order is converted from USD to EUR using the rate valid on the day the order is created, and your commission is calculated from that EUR amount. At payout, your balance converts from EUR into your chosen payout currency at the rate current at withdrawal. Two separate rates can therefore apply across a single commission: the order date rate sets the amount your commission is calculated from, and the payout date rate sets what you receive, so the final amount may differ slightly from a direct percentage of the price shown to the trader. Your FTMO level thresholds are also set in EUR while Futures is priced in USD, so exchange rate movement can affect where your monthly total sits relative to a threshold.

In FTMO US there is no conversion at any point: your commission is calculated directly from the USD order value and paid in USD, so the amount you see when a commission is approved is the amount you are paid.

What are the requirements for an affiliate payout?
What are the requirements for an affiliate payout?

Before you can withdraw your approved commissions, there are several requirements you must meet.

Identity verification (KYC/KYB): all partners must complete FTMO Identity verification before their first payout can be processed.
Tax documentation (FTMO US only): before your first FTMO US payout, you must complete a W-9 tax form in your dashboard.
Minimum payout balance: €50 in FTMO, $55 in FTMO US.

Once you meet these requirements, you can set up your withdrawal. FTMO payouts are available via bank transfer, Skrill or crypto, in EUR, USD or GBP. FTMO US payouts are processed via wire transfer, in USD.

Your FTMO and FTMO US balances are held separately and cannot be combined into a single payout.

What are the key promotional rules I must follow?
What are the key promotional rules I must follow?

To ensure a fair, transparent and long-term partnership, you must follow these key promotional rules. They apply to both programmes and all our products. Using unauthorised promotion is a reason for commissions to be rejected.

Key prohibitions
No self-referrals: you are strictly forbidden from signing up through your own affiliate link, and commissions from such orders will be rejected.
No brand bidding in paid ads: you may not bid on FTMO-branded keywords (for example ‘FTMO’, ‘FTMO US’, ‘FTMO Challenge’, ‘FTMO Instant Account’, ‘FTMO Futures’) in any paid advertising campaigns. This is considered a serious violation. Please also notify us at least 14 days in advance of launching any paid advertising campaign.
No brand impersonation: you must not create websites, social media profiles or advertisements that could mislead users into believing they are official FTMO channels.
No false claims about FTMO’s products or about discounts: misleading advertising can result in the termination of your Affiliate profile.
Using your rewards

When you receive a free FTMO product as a reward, you can use it yourself or give it away to your friends or followers. From the moment you receive the reward, any plan to use it as a giveaway, for example a contest, raffle or promotion, must first be reviewed and approved by the Affiliate Manager.

How do the FTMO and FTMO US Affiliate Programmes differ?
How do the FTMO and FTMO US Affiliate Programmes differ?

To ensure full compliance with local regulations in the United States, FTMO operates FTMO US, a distinct entity, JV Prop Corporation (FTMO US), dedicated to US clients, while the FTMO (Global) programme is operated by FTMO s.r.o. You promote both under one partner identity, but referrals, commissions, levels and payouts are tracked separately per programme, across all our products: 1-Step and 2-Step FTMO Challenge, FTMO Instant Account and FTMO Futures. Which entity provides which products is stated in these FAQs.

Affiliate Dashboard

The Affiliate Dashboard includes a programme switcher that lets you toggle between the FTMO and FTMO US views. Each view covers all products for that entity. The FTMO view tracks referrals and commissions from all non-US countries in EUR. The FTMO US view tracks referrals, sales and commissions generated from US clients in USD.

Affiliate links

Both programmes are available in your dashboard from the start. Switch to the FTMO US view and you will find your separate FTMO US affiliate link there. Your unique ID remains identical across both links. Smart redirection detects a client’s location automatically: US clients accessing an FTMO link are redirected to the FTMO US site, and non-US clients accessing an FTMO US link are redirected to the FTMO site. FTMO Futures is the exception: all clients, including US clients, purchase FTMO Futures on the global ftmo.com site.

Best practice is to use the FTMO US link for US-focused content and the FTMO link for all other promotions.

Levels and balances

Each programme runs its own level, calculated in its own currency, from its own commissions. The two never combine: your FTMO commissions cannot push up your FTMO US level or vice versa. Within each programme, all products count toward that programme’s level. Commission rates by level are identical in both programmes. The thresholds, currencies and payout methods differ as shown throughout this FAQ.

Because FTMO tracks in EUR and converts Futures orders from USD while FTMO US tracks natively in USD, equivalent sales can show slightly different figures in the two dashboard views.

Eligibility and restricted countries

Country restrictions differ between FTMO and FTMO US, and some apply to affiliates as well as to the clients they refer. See Are there countries where I cannot refer clients or receive payouts? for the full rules.

Proč bych se měl připojit k FTMO?
Proč bych se měl připojit k FTMO?

Obchodování je těžké. Při obchodování se můžete potýkat s řadou běžných problémů, například:

Obchodování na příliš malém účtu (podkapitalizace)
Strach ze ztráty vlastních peněz
Psychický tlak
Nedostatek disciplíny
Omezené možnosti růstu
Nedostatečná podpora okolí
Jak FTMO pomáhá?

Uživit se jako retailový trader, zvlášť pokud chcete obchodovat s vlastními prostředky, je náročné. S prop tradingovou firmou FTMO můžete své dovednosti zdokonalit a prokázat v FTMO Challenge nebo na FTMO Instant Accountu a za svou výkonnost dostávat skutečné peněžní výplaty, aniž byste na živých trzích riskovali vlastní kapitál.

Abyste z produktu FTMO Challenge získali odměnu, musíte nejprve postoupit do fáze FTMO Account. Simulovaný zisk vytvořený během Ověřovacího procesu vám nárok na odměnu nezakládá.

Naše tři produkty, 1-Step FTMO Challenge, 2-Step FTMO Challenge a FTMO Instant Account, vám umožňují zvolit si podmínky, které odpovídají vašemu obchodnímu stylu. U 2-Step FTMO Challenge vám vstupní poplatek vrátíme, jakmile požádáte o první výběr odměny, a to stejnou platební metodou, kterou jste použili.

Sami máme s tradingem zkušenosti, a proto víme, že k tomu, abyste byli skvělým traderem, potřebujete víc než jen dostatek kapitálu. Je v našem zájmu poskytnout klientům podmínky, díky kterým mohou podávat co nejlepší výkony. Naši klienti získají široký přístup k našim inovativním obchodním aplikacím, které jim mohou pomoci posílit jejich trading edge, a dostanou od nás i podrobnou zpětnou vazbu. FTMO Traderům a klientům s účtem FTMO Instant Account, kteří již otevřeli svůj první obchod, nabízíme také možnost pravidelných bezplatných konzultací s naším koučem psychologie tradingu.

V neposlední řadě klademe důraz na obchodní disciplínu. Na účtech FTMO si nemůžete dovolit žádnou ledabylost. Naše pravidla jsou nastavená tak, aby vás naučila profesionálním návykům řízení rizika a ve výsledku z vás udělala lepšího tradera.

Obchodujete na simulovaném obchodním účtu a musíte splnit všechna jeho Pravidla obchodování, například Profit Target a Konzistenci nebo Minimální dny obchodování (podle produktu), aniž byste porušili pravidlo Maximální ztráty nebo pravidlo Maximální denní ztráty. FTMO posuzuje splnění fáze Challenge okamžitě, jakmile splníte všechna Pravidla obchodování a zavřete všechny obchody. U 1-Step FTMO Challenge končí Ověřovací proces fází FTMO Challenge; fáze Verifikace se v tomto případě neuplatňuje.

Fáze 2: Verifikace

U 2-Step FTMO Challenge je fáze Verifikace zjednodušeným pokračováním fáze FTMO Challenge. Bez jejího splnění FTMO Account nezískáte.

Fáze 3: FTMO Account

Jakmile projdete Ověřovacím procesem a my potvrdíme vaše výsledky, získáte status FTMO Trader a svůj FTMO Account. Úspěšné výsledky na FTMO Account vám při dodržení pravidel vydělávají peněžní odměny.

FTMO Instant Account

FTMO Instant Account nemá fázi FTMO Challenge ani Verifikace. Pravidla obchodování ale platí. Tradeři musí i tak splnit požadavek na Konzistenci, aniž by porušili pravidlo Maximální ztráty nebo pravidlo Maximální denní ztráty. Úspěšné výsledky na FTMO Account vám při dodržení pravidel vydělávají peněžní odměny.
